conventions: Solomon's prayer formula: an apodosis waw before אתה תשמע / ושמעת takes the ASV's then; מן השמים → from heaven leaves the article unrepresented, while 6.27's bare השמים takes the supplied in under rule 33; מכון שבתך is rendered attributively as dwelling place (rule 28), with the מ taking from where written; the appositional even the ASV writes before the second from-phrase, and before the second thou of 6.30, is added, since no waw or marker stands on the phrase.

Verbs of the chapter: סלח ל → forgive leaves the ל unrepresented (6.25, 27, 39), while חטא ל → sin against gives the ל against (6.24, 26, 36, 39); שבה in any stem → carry/carried ... captive is one unit headed on captive (6.36, 37, 38); השיב אל לבב → bethink is one fused unit with the suffix taking themselves (6.37); עשה משפט → maintain ... cause gives maintain to the verb and cause to the noun (6.35, 39).

Phrasal particles are kept with their verb throughout (risen up 6.10, smitten down 6.24, kneeled down 6.13, shut up 6.26, spread forth 6.12/13/29, go out 6.34, turn away 6.42, turn again 6.24/37, bring again 6.25). The two borderline cases, risen up and smitten down, are read as the ASV's phrasal rendering rather than surplus particles, and each note names the added reading as the competitor.
report: Read all 42 verses end to end against the candidate table. No construction is analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.

Checked the recurring prayer-formula shapes: apodosis waw → then (6.23, 25, 27, 30, 33, 35, 39); מן השמים → from heaven with the article unrepresented, and 6.27's bare השמים → in heaven under rule 33; מכון שבתך → dwelling place attributively (6.21, 30, 33, 39) against 6.2's purpose infinitive to dwell; the supplied appositional even added in 6.20, 21, 30, 33, 39; this house/place with both articles unrepresented in every occurrence.

Checked the added-vs-folded axis the table cannot see: the stranded in of 6.2 and 6.5 is added in both; the two supplied object pronouns it (6.4, 6.15) are added in both; the coordinating and before an asyndetic member is added in 6.22, 6.26 and 6.29; every phrasal particle (risen up, smitten down, kneeled down, shut up, spread forth, go out, turn away, turn again, bring again) is kept with its verb, with the two borderline cases (6.10, 6.24) noting the competing reading.

Checked relative fusions: אשר fuses only where a resumptive morpheme stands (6.11 wherein is, 6.27 wherein, 6.30 whose, 6.37 whither) and stays bare where none does (6.20 whereof, 6.38 whither); 6.34's written which leaves בה unrepresented as rule 22 directs. 6.34's [הַ]+אשר → whatsoever and 6.29's כל…אשר → what…soever are each one fused unit on the terms of rule 35.
Supplied determiners are counted consistently: any man (6.5) and every man (6.29) join the anarthrous noun under rule 15, while 6.30's every goes to the assimilated article under rule 41.

BSB disagreements are all documented convention differences (unrendered R, To and Td morphemes, the three dimension suffixes of 6.13, the paragogic nun of 6.26 and he of 6.41–42, the resumptive הוא of 6.32 and the resumptive suffixes of 6.34 and 6.36). None is a genuine error.
No promotion: the chapter's judgments are applications of rules 14, 22, 28, 40, 44 and 46 already in the contract.
